name: Google Agent Skills
summary: Google's official Agent Skills for Google products and Google Cloud, also bundled as plugins (skills + MCP servers) for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.
description: Install with `npx skills add google/skills`; update with `npx skills update`. Plugin installs: `claude plugin marketplace add google/skills`, `codex plugin marketplace add google/skills`. Repo created 2026-03-31.
